37400.meaning2: having let fall, having thrown down into

examples.text: atha kho jīvako komārabhacco seṭṭhiṃ gahapatiṃ mañcake nipātetvā sambandhitvā sīsacchaviṃ uppāṭetvā sibbiniṃ vināmetvā dve pāṇake nīharitvā mahājanassa dassesi.
te taṃ saṅkhaṃ avakujjaṃ nipātesuṃ, passena nipātesuṃ, dutiyena passena nipātesuṃ… vadehi, bho saṅkha, vadehi, bho saṅkhā'ti. n'eva so saṅkho saddam'akāsi.

37403.meaning1: (of a word) spat out; imputed; dropped a slur

examples.text: itiha ambaṭṭho māṇavo idaṃ paṭhamaṃ sakyesu ibbhavādaṃ nipātesi.

37405.meaning2: watering place or a trough for cattle, etc.

examples.text: sabbhi'r'eva samāsetha, paṇḍiteh'atthadassibhi, atthaṃ mahantaṃ gambhīraṃ, duddasaṃ nipuṇaṃ aṇuṃ, dhīrā samadhigacchanti, appamattā vicakkhaṇā'ti.
anomanāmaṃ nipuṇ'atthadassiṃ, paññādadaṃ kām'ālaye asattaṃ, taṃ passatha sabbaviduṃ sumedhaṃ, ariye pathe kamamānaṃ mahesin'ti.

37407.meaning1: astute; skilled; shrewd; (comm) knowing how to do refined work

examples.text: dullabho, bhikkhave, vuḍḍhapabbajito nipuṇo, dullabho ākappasampanno, dullabho bahussuto, dullabho dhammakathiko, dullabho vinayadharo.
katamāni cattāri? idh'āhaṃ, bho, passāmi ekacce khattiyapaṇḍite nipuṇe kataparappavāde vālavedhirūpe, te bhindantā maññe caranti paññāgatena diṭṭhigatāni.

37408.meaning1: leading to the subtle; going to the elusive

examples.text: nipuṇañ'ca vo, bhikkhave, desessāmi nipuṇagāmiñ'ca maggaṃ. taṃ suṇātha.

37409.meaning1: who sees the subtle truth; who perceives the subtle goal; (comm) who sees the subtle meanings
37409.commentary: (SNa) nipuṇ'atthadassin'ti bhagavā saṇhasukhume khandh'antar'ādayo atthe passatī'ti nipuṇ'atthadassī.

examples.text: anomanāmaṃ nipuṇ'atthadassiṃ, paññādadaṃ kām'ālaye asattaṃ, taṃ passatha sabbaviduṃ sumedhaṃ, ariye pathe kamamānaṃ mahesin'ti.
taṃ veyyañjanikā samāgatā bahavo, byākaṃsu nipuṇasammatā manujā, sucijanaparivāragaṇo bhavati, dijasamasukkasucisobhanadanto.
yaṃnūn'āhaṃ sappiṃ nippaceyyaṃ kasāvavaṇṇaṃ kasāvagandhaṃ kasāvarasan'ti. atha kho jīvako komārabhacco nānābhesajjehi sappiṃ nippaci kasāvavaṇṇaṃ kasāvagandhaṃ kasāvarasaṃ.

37413.meaning2: flies out, rushes out; falls out; departs, hastens away

37415.meaning1: having flown out; having fallen to the side

37417.meaning2: all-embracing, not leaving a portion aside, comprehensive, inclusive

37418.meaning1: not forming various opinions; without proliferating; epithet of Nibbāna

examples.text: ākāse'va padaṃ n'atthi, samaṇo n'atthi bāhire, papañc'ābhiratā pajā, nippapañcā tathāgatā.
nāgassa pantasenassa, khīṇasaṃyojanassa muttassa, paṭimantakassa dhonassa, pannadhajassa vītarāgassa, dantassa nippapañcassa, bhagavato tassa sāvako'ham'asmi.
nippapañc'ārāmass'āyaṃ dhammo nippapañcaratino n'āyaṃ dhammo papañc'ārāmassa papañca-ratino'ti
sammā byākaramānā, bhikkhave, aññatitthiyā paribbājakā evaṃ byākareyyuṃ, nippapañc'ārāmass'āvuso, sā niṭṭhā nippapañcaratino, na sā niṭṭhā papañc'ārāmassa papañcaratino'ti.

37420.meaning1: leading to the absence of proliferation; going to not forming various opinions

examples.text: nippapañcañ'ca vo, bhikkhave, desessāmi nippapañcagāmiñ'ca maggaṃ. taṃ suṇātha.

37421.meaning1: state of nonproliferation; state without conceptualization; (comm) state of Nibbāna

37422.meaning1: taking pleasure in mental nonproliferation; not addicted to manifold ideas

examples.text: sā pan'āvuso, niṭṭhā papañc'ārāmassa papañcaratino udāhu nippapañc'ārāmassa nippapañcaratino'ti? sammā byākaramānā, bhikkhave, aññatitthiyā paribbājakā evaṃ byākareyyuṃ, nippapañc'ārāmass'āvuso, sā niṭṭhā nippapañcaratino, na sā niṭṭhā papañc'ārāmassa papañcaratino'ti.
nippapañc'ārāmass'āyaṃ dhammo nippapañcaratino n'āyaṃ dhammo papañc'ārāmassa papañcaratino'ti

37423.meaning1: enjoying mental nonproliferation; not taking pleasure in manifold ideas

examples.text: sā pan'āvuso, niṭṭhā papañc'ārāmassa papañcaratino udāhu nippapañc'ārāmassa nippapañcaratino'ti? sammā byākaramānā, bhikkhave, aññatitthiyā paribbājakā evaṃ byākareyyuṃ, nippapañc'ārāmass'āvuso, sā niṭṭhā nippapañcaratino, na sā niṭṭhā papañc'ārāmassa papañcaratino'ti.

37424.meaning1: fact of enjoying mental nonproliferation; fact of not taking pleasure in manifold ideas

examples.text: na kamm'ārāmatā, na bhass'ārāmatā, na nidd'ārāmatā, na saṅgaṇik'ārāmatā, indriyesu guttadvāratā, bhojane mattaññutā, asaṃsagg'ārāmatā, nippapañc'ārāmatā.

37425.construction:
nir + pa + √bhā + ā + a
nippabhā + a

examples.text: ayaṃ pan'ettha saṅkhepo, bhagavato kira bhikkhusaṅghassa ca pañcannaṃ mahānadīnaṃ mah'oghasadise lābhasakkāre uppanne hatalābhasakkārā aññatitthiyā sūriy'uggamanakāle khajjopanakā viya nippabhā hutvā ekato sannipatitvā mantayiṃsu.

37431.grammar: ind, adv, instr sg of nippariyāya, neg
37431.construction:
nir + pari + [y] + √i > ay + *a + ena
nippariyāya + ena
37431.commentary: (ANa) nippariyāyenā'ti yattakaṃ kāyena sacchikātabbaṃ, sabbassa katattā ayaṃ nippariyāyena kāyasakkhi nāma.

examples.text: yathā yathā ca tadāyatanaṃ tathā tathā naṃ kāyena phusitvā viharati. ettāvatā'pi kho, āvuso, kāyasakkhī vutto bhagavatā nippariyāyenā'ti.

37432.meaning1: free from chatter; without idle talk

examples.text: atha kho bhagavā tuṇhībhūtaṃ tuṇhībhūtaṃ bhikkhusaṅghaṃ anuviloketvā bhikkhū āmantesi, apalāp'āyaṃ, bhikkhave, parisā, nippalāp'āyaṃ, bhikkhave, parisā, suddhā sāre patiṭṭhitā.

37433.grammar: aor of caus of nī √pat, caus, trans (+acc)
37433.commentary: (VINa) n'āyyo so bhikkhu maṃ nippātesī'ti ayyo ayaṃ bhikkhu maṃ na nikkhāmesi, na maṃ gahetvā agamāsī'ti attho.

37434.commentary: (SNPa) nippāpo… pahīnapāpattā nippāpo (JAa) niddaro hoti nippāpo'ti sabbakilesadarathābhāvena niddaro, kilesābhāvena nippāpo hoti.

examples.text: pavivekarasaṃ pitvā, rasaṃ upasamassa ca, niddaro hoti nippāpo, dhammapītirasaṃ pivaṃ.

37437.meaning1: without delight; not connected with joy

examples.text: so imam'eva kāyaṃ nippītikena sukhena abhisandeti parisandeti paripūreti parippharati

imaṃ samādhiṃ savitakkam'pi savicāraṃ bhāveyyāsi, avitakkam'pi vicāramattaṃ bhāveyyāsi, avitakkam'pi avicāraṃ bhāveyyāsi, sappītikam'pi bhāveyyāsi, nippītikam'pi bhāveyyāsi, sātasahagatam'pi bhāveyyāsi, upekkhāsahagatam'pi bhāveyyāsi.

37438.meaning1: based on no delight; founded on the absence of heartfelt joy
37438.commentary: (ANa) sappītik'ārammaṇan'ti sappītikaṃ jhānadvayaṃ paccavekkhantassa uppannasukhaṃ. nippītik'ārammaṇepi es'eva nayo.

examples.text: katamāni dve? sappītik'ārammaṇañ'ca sukhaṃ nippītik'ārammaṇañ'ca sukhaṃ. imāni kho, bhikkhave, dve sukhāni.

37441.grammar: prp of pass of nī √pīḷ, pass, intrans (+instr)
37441.meaning1: being pressured; being pushed; being forced (by)

37447.commentary: (MNa) nippurisehī'ti purisavirahitehi. na kevalañ'c'ettha tūriyān'eva nippurisāni, sabbaṭṭhānāni'pi nippurisān'eva. dovārikā'pi itthiyo'va, nhāpan'ādiparikammakarā'pi itthiyo'va. rājā kira, tathārūpaṃ issariyasukhasampattiṃ anubhavamānassa purisaṃ disvā parisaṅkā uppajjati, sā me puttassa mā ahosī'ti sabbakiccesu itthiyo'va ṭhapesi.

examples.text: so kho ahaṃ, māgaṇḍiya, vassike pāsāde vassike cattāro māse nippurisehi tūriyehi paricārayamāno na heṭṭhāpāsādaṃ orohāmi.

yathā vā pan'eke bhonto samaṇabrāhmaṇā saddhādeyyāni bhojanāni bhuñjitvā te kuhakā ca honti, lapakā ca nemittikā ca nippesikā ca, lābhena lābhaṃ nijigīṃsitāro ca iti evarūpā kuhanalapanā paṭivirato samaṇo gotamo'ti
katamo ca, bhikkhave, micchāājīvo? kuhanā, lapanā, nemittikatā, nippesikatā, lābhena lābhaṃ nijigisanatā, ayaṃ, bhikkhave, micchāājīvo.
seyyathā'pi nāma balavā soṇḍikādhutto vālaṃ kaṇṇe gahetvā odhuneyya niddhuneyya nippoṭheyya

37454.commentary: (SNa) nippothento āgacchatī'ti pathavitalato yāva akaniṭṭhabrahmalokā sabbe satte saṇhakaraṇīyaṃ tiṇacuṇṇaṃ viya karonto pisanto āgacchati. (SNt) nippothento'ti nimmaddento. saṇhakaraṇīyaṃ atisaṇhaṃ pisanto nisadapoto viya pisanto. (VISMa) nippothentā'ti attanā āghātitaṃ cuṇṇavicuṇṇaṃ karontā.

examples.text: tatth'addasaṃ mahantaṃ pabbataṃ abbhasamaṃ sabbe pāṇe nippothento āgacchati.

37455.meaning2: is produced, springs forth, results, happens

examples.text: tattha katakammā kammassa nipphannattā sattānaṃ galalohitaṃ gahetvā devatānaṃ baliṃ karonti, akatakammā evaṃ no kammaṃ nipphajjissatī'ti paṭhamataraṃ karonti. idaṃ sandhāya te maṃ jīvitā voropeyyun'ti vuttaṃ.

37457.meaning2: being produced, springing forth, resulting, happening

37458.meaning2: was produced, sprung forth, resulted, happened

37459.meaning2: having been produced, having sprung forth, having resulted, having happened

examples.text: mahāsatto hi tadā mahati uḷārabhoge kule nibbattitvā vuddhim'anvāya disāpāmokkhassa ācariyassa santike garuvāsaṃ vasanto sabbasippānaṃ nipphattiṃ patvā kulagharaṃ āgantvā mātāpitūnaṃ accayena ñātakehi, kuṭumbaṃ saṇṭhapehī'ti

37464.commentary: (SNa) nipphadā'ti nipphatti, yāva attho nipphajjati, tāva vāyameth'evā'ti vadati. dutiyagāthā sakkassa.

examples.text: vāyameth'eva puriso, yāva atthassa nipphadā, nipphannasobhano attho, verocanavaco idan'ti.

37465.meaning2: not trembling; not quivering; not shivering; not palpitating

examples.text: adhikāre maṅgale c'eva, nipphanne c'āvadhāraṇe, anantare c'apādāne, athasaddo pavattati.

37469.meaning1: fact of being produced; fact of being made (from)
37469.construction:
nī + √pad > phad + na + tta
nipphanna + tta

examples.text: yathā pana dāruādīhi nipphannāni tāni tāni bhaṇḍāni dārumay'ādīni nāma honti, tathā te'pi manato nipphannattā manomayā nāma.

37470.meaning1: splendid when accomplished; beautiful when achieved
37470.commentary: (SNa) nipphannasobhano attho'ti ime atthā nāma nipphannā'va sobhanti. (SNt) nipphannasobhanesū'ti nipphannabhāvena sundaresu. sabbe hi anipphannā atthā na sobhanti.

examples.text: vāyameth'eva puriso, yāva atthassa nipphadā, nipphannasobhano attho, verocanavaco idan'ti.

37471.meaning1: splendid when accomplished; beautiful when achieved
37471.commentary: (SNa) nipphannasobhano attho'ti ime atthā nāma nipphannā'va sobhanti.

examples.text: vāyameth'eva puriso, yāva atthassa nipphadā, nipphannasobhino attho, khantyā bhiyyo na vijjatī'ti.
evam'eva kho, mahārāja, yaṃ taṃ tejaṃ viriyaṃ nippharati, taṃ pacch'ābhinibbattaṃ, n'āhaṃ tattha kiñci nānākaraṇaṃ vadāmi, yadidaṃ vimuttiyā vimuttin'ti.

37473.meaning1: without fruit; in vain; without success

examples.text: sabbam'eva hi nūn'etaṃ, suciṇṇaṃ bhavati nipphalaṃ, niratthaṃ maññidaṃ sīlaṃ, alāto bhāsatī yathā.

37480.meaningLit: to cause to be gone out

37482.synonym: uppādayati, uppādeti, janeti, pavatteti, pasavati, pātukaroti, savati

37484.meaning2: having produced, having brought forth, having accomplished

37487.grammar: fem, abstr, act, in comps, from nipphoṭeti
37487.commentary: (SNa) pavāḷanipphoṭanāyā'ti pāvaḷanipphoṭanato, bhūmiyaṃ nisīdantassa ānisadaṭṭhāne laggānaṃ paṃsurajavālikānaṃ phoṭan'atthaṃ gahitamorapiñchamattato'ti attho.

examples.text: imehi kho me, gahapati, tiṃsamattehi vassehi pabbajitassa n'atthi koci uttarimanussadhammā alam'ariya-ñāṇadassana-viseso adhigato phāsuvihāro, aññatra naggeyyā ca muṇḍeyyā ca pāvaḷanipphoṭanāya cā'ti
seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, pabbajalāyako pabbajaṃ lāyitvā agge gahetvā odhunāti niddhunāti nipphoṭeti

37491.meaning2: having beat down, having smothered, having crushed

37495.commentary: (JAa) kaṭṭhaṃ niplavitaṃ seyyo'ti nadiyā vuyhamānaṃ sukkhadāruṃ niplavitaṃ uttāretvā thale ṭhapitaṃ seyyo sundarataro.

examples.text: saccaṃ kir'evam'āhaṃsu, narā ekacciyā idha, kaṭṭhaṃ niplavitaṃ seyyo, na tv'ev'ekacciyo naro'ti.
